newsitem.title: USA: Dominick's says committed to equal opportunity.
newsitem.headline: Dominick's says committed to equal opportunity.

text.p: Dominick's Supermarkets Inc, the subject of a class-action sex discrimination lawsuit, said Wednesday it is committed to equal opportunities for women.
"I am committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for women at Dominick's," Robert Marion, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
The company said the National Organization for Women would like to discuss workplace discrimination issues with Dominick's.

"We look forward to meeting with them to listen to their ideas and share with them our ongoing efforts to ensure a healthy corporate culture that provides equal opportunities for all Dominick's employees," Marion said.

In April, Dominick's said it would vigorously defend itself against a class-action lawsuit, originally filed in March 1995 when the company was privately held. The suit charged that the company had failed to provide the same promotion opportunities, work experience and training to women that it had provided to men.
